notes.title: Double Kick Heroes Launch News
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33190580/0d6405daa2806137658a3299673160ab4bed0dda.gif[/img]

[b]🤘 The wait is almost over! 🤘[/b]

We wanted to let you know that Double Kick Heroes will be leaving Early Access on August 13th 😈

It’s time to jump out of the mosh-pit and into your Gundillac, Sheila, and take on the baddest of badasses and survive in this metal moshing and mayhemic post-apocalyptic nightmarish wasteland.

"[i]Man, it’s been a long journey but we’re pumped to be finally sharing Double Kick Heroes with you all[/i]" [b]David Elahee - Headbang Club[/b]. [i]"We hope that you love our game as much as we do and enjoy the kick-ass soundtrack we’ve put together to celebrate all things metal. We can’t wait for people to try out air controls for Nintendo Switch which is a heap load of metallic fun, but please drum responsibly"[/i].

As well as leaving Early Access, Double Kick Heroes will launch on Nintendo Switch on August 13th, followed by a simultaneous release on Game Pass for Xbox One and PC and the Xbox and Microsoft Store on August 28th!!!

https://youtu.be/rcynIN9i3cw

If you've not been following our road through Early Access, here are some features you can expect on August 13th: 

[list][*] A full story mode that’s accompanied by 50 kerranging songs, including the OST Volume 2 Update, by top artists such as Ultra Vomit, Volkorx, Gorod, Jinjer, Carpenter Brut and Gojira!
[*] Unique Rhythm shooter mashup with incredibly detailed pixel art
[*] 5 difficulty settings to test even the most metal of metal head’s skills
[*] Tons of accessibility options
[*] USB drum and guitar support on PC (and Xbox One)[/list]

In addition to this, we have some Nintendo Switch Joy Con Alternative Motion Control Methods prepared for launch including: 

[list][*] Air drumming - Joy Con used as drumsticks, keeping in rhythm of game
[*] Air beat - Can't drum? No Problem! Stomp to the beat with your Joy Con
[*] Want the all out motion controlled experience and really put that double kick pedal to the metal? Then it's time to use two sets of Joy Con, one in your socks and one in your hands and drum and stomp your way through the apocalypse![/list]

We can't wait for you to get your hands on Double Kick Heroes and want to thank everyone for joining us on this journey. 

Don't forget to [url=https://twitter.com/headbang_club]follow us on Twitter[/url] for more news and announcements in the build-up to launch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33190580/a7cca7e89a4b10f4c69af4f6e250dd578ebdeba6.png[/img]

notes.title: Announcing NAIRI: Rising Tide 🌊 - coming 2021
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33190580/9aabf95a05cb188a139380710b6a577321688f48.png[/img]

The wait is finally over and we're thrilled to finally be able to tell you that Rising Tide 🌊 from [b]HomeBearStudio[/b] is in development and aiming for a 2021 release.

You can wishlist Rising Tide right now! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1225200/NAIRI_Rising_Tide/

[b]The story continues in the second chapter of NAIRI![/b]
After the events of NAIRI: Tower of Shirin, Nairi continues on her quest to save her family. While she and her companions try to overcome the many dangers of the corrupt city of Shirin, an apocalyptic prophecy threatens to devour everything.

[b]Announcement Trailer:[/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PhyKYhLVO3M

[b]Features:[/b]
[list][*] Lively interconnected overworld, complete with mysterious ruins waiting to be discovered!
[*] Delve into secluded puzzle-dungeons and solve their many challenging brainteasers!
[*] Charming, yet melancholic, story written to captivate players of any age!
[*] Unique, lovingly hand-drawn art style reminiscent of Studio Ghibli and Disney!
[*] Tons of all-new characters ready to charm you… and ask for your help!
[*] Brand new quality-of-life features, such as a map and fast-travel system!
[*] A reworked inventory system allows for more creative item combinations!
[*] More interesting rewards and treasures to collect!
[*] More customizable hint system to better tailor your experience![/list]

[b]NAIRI: Rising Tide Demo[/b]

Coming on May 21st this year (that's just two weeks away!) we're releasing a free demo of Rising Tide for you to get a sneak peek of gameplay and sets the scene for what will be an exciting second chapter!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1225060/NAIRI_Rising_Tide__Prologue/

Don't forget to wishlist the demo separately to be alerted as soon as it is released 😍

[b]The official NAIRI Chapters Discord:[/b]

We're also excited to announce that we've recently launched a brand new Discord community, 100% focused on Nairi, Rex and the adventures that await them in both Tower of Shirin and Rising Tide.

https://discord.gg/nairi

[u]Reasons to join:[/u]
[list][*] Be among the first to hear about development news and updates
[*] Invites to testing sessions
[*] Fanart
[*] Developer discussions and AMA sessions
[*] Giveaways, competitions and much, much more as we continue development.[/list]

Don't worry if you don't use Discord, we'll still be updating Steam with news as it happens!🥰 Just be sure to wishlist Rising Tide for monthly updates.

Don't forget, NAIRI: Tower of Shirin is just £3.99 on Steam or you can grab the Deluxe Edition which includes the NAIRI TOS OST and Artbook! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/802450/NAIRI_Tower_of_Shirin/

notes.title: HyperParasite is out now!
notes.content:
What a journey it has been, but today we are thrilled to announce that HyperParasite has left Early Access and 1.0 is available RIGHT NOW here on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/838110/HyperParasite/

We’re also super excited to announce that the game is available globally on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. 

It’s brand new trailer time! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=18Y7CLiJD60

From everyone here at Hound Picked Games and Troglobytes Games, we want to thank each and every one of you for your support and encouragement throughout development, Early Access and eventual launch. 

We’ve been humbled by the critic reviews, the sheer number of streamers and content creators requesting to check out HyperParasite, and the feedback you the players have given us since we launched into EA. 

[h1]Launch Discounts 💰[/h1]

HyperParasite has launched with discounts across [b]ALL[/b] platforms: 

Here on Steam, you can bag yourself a copy of the game with 33% off for a limited time until April 18th. 

This discount is also available on [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/hyperparasite/c1nb0h6pjmjl][b]Xbox One[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/product/EP1935-CUSA18306_00-HYPERPARASITEAEU][b]PlayStation 4[/b][/url] until April 18th.

Our [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/hyperparasite-switch/][b]Nintendo Switch[/b][/url] publishing partner has set up the following exciting promotions:  
[list][*] EU - 24th March - 18th April 33% discount for all pre-orders and purchases
[*] EU - 24th March - 18th April 50% discount for all QubicGames customers
[*] NA - 24th March - 12th April 33% discount for all pre-orders and purchases
[*] NA - 24th March - 18th April 50% discount for all QubicGames customers[/list] 

[h1]HyperParasite Reviews[/h1]

[list][*][url=https://www.savingcontent.com/2020/04/02/hyperparasite-review/][b]Saving Content[/b][/url] - [i]This is the definition of a Steam Early Access success. HyperParasite excites and delights every time you play it.[/i]

The gameplay is tight, the concept is marvelously unique and you feel rewarded with each playthrough as you unlock more host bodies to control.[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Update #16 - Let's Talk About Act 4 & Release Dates
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/4436db186c9e45d7ca304d07f424b6f4a37e5d77.gif[/img]

It’s Gamescom week, Parasites, and this week’s update is the largest one to date. We’ve got a ton of stuff to get through including new content (did we mention Act 4 is now complete?), what’s happening at Gamescom, release date news and much more. Shall we begin?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/74f3a0af6908e2804948be1efc257506cdfd2614.gif[/img]

[h1]What’s NEW in 0.1908.1[/h1]

[list][*]Completed Act 4: The Desert.
[*]Completed The Desert level.
[*]Added new themed rooms to The Desert.
[*]Added new secrets to The Desert.
[*]Added Area 81 sublevel with new character classes, themed rooms, traps, secrets etc.
[*]Added a brand new character class (as playable and AI character): the Alien Creature.
[*]Added a brand new character class (as playable and AI character): the Researcher.
[*]Updated & added character descriptions in the Almanac.[/list] 

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed quicksand traps.
[*]Fixed Space Huntress’ primary attack.
[*]Fixed Space Huntress’ special attack.
[*]Fixed Pyromaniac’s special attack.
[*]Fixed characters’ GUI.
[*]Fixed Werewolf Pre Attack (as miniboss).
[*]Fixed miniboss rooms unlocking behavior.
[*]Fixed some Old Sewers rooms.
[*]Fixed Third Boss shop room.
[*]Fixed Fourth Boss shop room.[/list]

[b]NEW TRAILER ALERT FOR ACT 4![/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vhh7Fcds_B4&feature=youtu.be

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/ba968bd9a44056400506677e225619d1b8a131d4.gif[/img]

[h1]Gamescom 2019[/h1]

We’re here! We made it to Gamescom and Saverio (the boss Parasite here at Troglobytes HQ) is on hand with this brand new build of HyperParasite. Everything above is ready and waiting.  We can’t wait to show press, influencers and visitors what we have been working on implementing. Come and visit us in Hall 10.1 in the Entertainment Area of the Spanish Pavilion. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33190580/014783816343cf2128cb3b252805485f32020bbb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Release Date Update + New Price[/h1]

Since we released HyperParasite on Steam Early Access, the game has received weekly updates including two complete brand new acts, developer and community gameplay streams, a shit ton of new characters, levels, mini-bosses, BIG bosses, gameplay mechanics and quality of life features. As we continue to add more and more to the game, we feel it’s now the right time to increase the price from $10.99 to $12.99. Boss Parasite Saverio released the following statement to the video game press earlier today; 

“With the implementation of Act 4, we feel it’s the right time to increase the price from $10.99 to $12.99, which we feel still offers incredible value for money. If you’re at Gamescom, we’d love to show you how far our game has come along in development since our initial Early Access release!”

In addition to the pricing update, we’re also announcing that our planned full, and final, release for HyperParasite will now be Q1 2020. This gives our team the time required to complete not just the Steam build, but the Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch build too. We’ll continue to keep you updated here via the Steam store page and [url=https://twitter.com/_Troglobytes_]here on Twitter[/url]. 

[b]Wishlist now![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/838110/HyperParasite/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/17531bc104659dbb815b96d81c98f16636eac4e8.gif[/img]

[h1]WEEKLY STREAM[/h1]
It’s Gamescom week, so things are MAD busy here. We’ll be doing our best to do some live streaming here on Steam, so keep an eye on our [url=https://twitter.com/_Troglobytes_]Twitter[/url] account for live updates. 

Don’t forget to follow us on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/troglobytes/]Twitch[/url] too!

If you’re a streamer on Mixer, and want to be hosted by Hound Picked’s new channel, whilst getting hands on with HyperParasite, then let us know hyperparasite@houndpicked.com. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/0ed2ccefdae60f979600cdf6a09760ccc6352533.gif[/img]

[h1]COMMUNITY NEWS[/h1]

Don’t forget about the brand new [url=https://hyperparasite.gamepedia.com/Hyper_Parasite]HyperParasite Wiki[/url], which went live last week, thanks to our friends over at GamePedia. Since launch, it’s been updated with all the character descriptions and weapon info, with more to come in the following weeks.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/a1baed1d03a759f0952b36395bfc86c6cecb6bc0.gif[/img]

notes.title: Price Drop! New Trading Cards, Achievements and bug fixes for Dystoria!
notes.content:
[h1]Price Drop![/h1]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

We've added 12 new achievements! Check them out on the Dystoria page to find out how to earn them.

[h1]Trading Cards[/h1]

There are now 7 new trading cards for you to collect featuring some of the ships of Dystoria! This also includes badges for collecting full sets and emoticons.

[h1]What's New in Dystoria[/h1]

New: In the map view - added labels to ship, orbs and exit.
New: Labels on badges so you know how to earn each one.
New: Minor level edits to smooth out congested areas.
New: Dialogue is now skippable

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]

Fixed: Map view, parts of the level disappearing.
Fixed: Kryoccian 2 Endless death loop - spawning at a checkpoint and being attacked by enemy before level start.
Fixed: Level stats not saving highest scores.
Fixed: Embryis 7 Nucleon stats incorrectly reported.
Fixed: Time counter occasionally not stopping when player dies
Fixed: Enemies moving through walls in some sectors
Fixed: Zuruli 2 Exit lauched ship into a transporter
Fixed: Enemies attacking after you exit sector
Fixed: Shield/health continue to drop if entering a transporter while under attack
Fixed: Enemies firing when player not visible
Fixed: Mouse icon appears during boss fight
Fixed: Miscalculation of some level stats (Nucleons and enemies)

Many more minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Feb 8 Updates and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you so much to everyone who has been submitting bugs and suggestions. You guys rock, and we've been listening to everything you say and making changes based on your feedback. 

We've been working hard to hammer out the last of the little details before launch. Check it out!


[H1]UPDATES:[/H1]

-Abduction Cut Scene, now shows UFO joining up with the mothership.
-Added Graphics options to menu
-Added Keyboard and Gamepad remapping
-Added Difficulty levels (easy, normal, hard, insanity) May need balancing
-Added Time to level complete menu
-Changed some player stats to percentages instead of fractions
-Added soundfx to boss projectiles
-Added new ship (Quadrex)
-Balanced Ship Specs
-Balanced weapons
-Unlocked first 2 ships at beginning of game
-Map view highlights ship, orbs, and exit locations.
-Added beta testers to end credits


[H1]FIXES:[/H1]
-Issues with controller sensitivity in substation on New Game (only affects some systems - needs testing)
-Bombs explode while game is paused
-Using map view after entering exit portal caused "Ship Decoupled" and would fail the sector.
-Mouse Icon shows up after dialogue in Boss level
-Cutscene-Flickering light stayed on after arcade cab disappered
-Substation Menu, launch button disappeared when tabbing back through ship select menu.
-Wrong Nucleon and Enemy count in some sectors
-Menu glitch allowed unlocking weapons without sufficient Nucleons.
-Nexus Ship had wrong texture
-Solterria 3 Camera didn't follow ship
-Embryis 6 Laser field out of alignment
-Grammar errors in some dialogue
-Transporter out of alignment in Embryis 6

notes.title: DYSTORIA Beta Testing - Major Update
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you to all of you who have been beta testing Dystoria![/h1]

Today we have released a [b]major update[/b] that brings Dystoria from 10 Levels to 29 Levels, adds new music, weapons, ships, story revamp and a huge pile of bug fixes based on the feedback that we have had so far.

There are also some [b]performance enhancements[/b] that will give people with lower spec computers a significant increase in frame rate and overall smoothness of gameplay.

[h1][b]***Please Note*** [/b][/h1]
If you have previously been playing Dystoria, this update will break your save file which will cause issues throughout the entire game. To fix this, please start a new game after you get this update.

As always, if there's any bugs that you spot, please let us know on our [url=http://www.dystoria.com/community/]Forum[/url] and we will post fixes ASAP.

[h1]Known issues we are currently addressing:[/h1]

Incorrect music plays in some sectors
Missing Weapon "Regenerator"
Weapon Loadout Menu Secondary Weapon sometimes disappears from Loadout
Occasionally Ship Speed, Handling and Camera Settings fail to initialize at the beginning of the level. (Pause and Unpause works as a temp fix)

notes.title: New Updates
notes.content:
We are working hard every day to update and we are listening carefully to each and every suggestion that we hear. Thank you to those of you who have helped us out so much with testing the alpha version!

[h1]What's New[/h1]

- 2 new levels (we added 2 introductory levels at the beginning of the game to help learn the movement mechanics before you start getting shot at)

- 3 new ships. The cost and specs of each ship will definitely be changing over the course of beta testing

- The story now progresses via pop up computer screen at the completion of each sector

- Save points - some levels now have a midway save point. More will be added as play-testing identifies trouble spots.

- Orbs now only need to be collected once. If you die and restart, you keep the orbs you've collected until you exit the level or return to the substation.

- Camera distance and smoothing controls in the pause menu

- Keyboard/Mouse/Gamepad layout updated in menu.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

- All ship and camera movement is no longer tied to the frame rate of the game. It should make the controls a lot smoother and consistent across different machines. This should also fix issues where the ship becomes decoupled too easily.

- Switching between mouse controls and game pad controls is now more intelligently managed. This needs testing. Please let us know if you encounter any menus where gamepad support fails.

- Default Camera position is now low. The camera button toggles between low and high.

[h1]Known issues:[/h1]

Camera button incorrectly mapped on xbox controller

Camera snaps to wrong position when ship is decoupled

notes.title: Freeze on loading screen issue solved
notes.content:
Along with fixing the loading issue we've made some minor improvements. The pause menu is now updated with a few more settings screens, and the same settings menu is now used in the Substation as well.

Gamepad control map is now shown in the menu, however we are still figuring out how to map all the gamepads the same way, so bear with us as we make those changes. Some buttons may not be mapped exactly how the picture shows just yet.

Supported controllers include Xbox One, Xbox 360 and Logitech F-310, and of course keyboard and mouse.

Added intelligent control sensing when switching from keyboard and mouse to gamepad (no more mouse cursor on the screen when using gamepad)

Fixed Vertical look speed issue in Substation.

Fixed look sensitivity not working in Substation.
